intro.text: A priest in Hallandren's Court of Gods who feeds Vasher information about court politics.

items.text: Over a meal at a restaurant, Bebid tells Vasher about a faction at court that wants to attack Idris. Vasher has some hold over him, having broken him once, which Bebid felt was no easy thing. He can't help with Vasher's other plans, as he moves in the wrong circles, so he mentions Bluefingers instead.
